_readme: Undefined names (ESLint no-undef) in src/ when the gate was turned on (NodeCanvas refactor P0.06).
scripts/check-undefined-names.mjs (npm run lint:undef) fails CI on any new one, and on entries that are gone.
Most real entries are latent ReferenceErrors: a path that calls them throws. process/Buffer/require are Node-only files linted as browser code.
This list only shrinks. Never add an entry to get a red build green.
